Container.Name: CrowdSec Unraid Bouncer
Container.Overview: Unraid firewall bouncer for CrowdSec. It consumes CrowdSec Local API decisions and applies them to host and Docker-published traffic through iptables, with ipset support for large global lists, health notifications through Unraid and Telegram, and optional CrowdSec Threat Map drops export through a capped JSONL feed.
